title: One gateway in front of a Kubernetes service
recordedWith: connectors 0.52.0 built from source, the federation guide's configuration, no Kubernetes cluster

entries.comment: A federation host lists its downstream operations under their source prefix.
entries.command: connectors describe --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:17100/ --allow-plaintext --token-file gateway.secret | jq '{instance, operations: [.operations[].id]}'

entries.comment: No cluster answers behind the Kubernetes service: the refusal is named and nothing is retried.
entries.command: connectors invoke --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:17100/ --allow-plaintext --token-file gateway.secret --operation kubernetes__resources.list --input pods.json
